callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no A. a monitor lizard the size of a canoe, light sliding wrong off its back, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 1 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Mei Haddad. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Sanne Okafor. From Stonebridge." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Peter Osei and Ines Murphy and Aisha Santos and Nadia Osei and Maya Larsen and Sanne Petrov will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Ruth Weiss and Zoe Rhee will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Omar Park and Jesse Silva will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
